a2-past-raah.title: Past Tense: I Went, You Went...
a2-past-raah.pattern: رحت / رحت / رحتي / راح / راحت / رحنا / رحتو / راحو
a2-past-raah.explanation: The past tense of راح (raah, "to go") is formed with suffixes attached to the root ر-و-ح: رحت (riHt, "I went"), رحت (riHt, "you-m went"), رحتي (riHti, "you-f went"), راح (raah, "he went"), راحت (raaHat, "she went"), رحنا (riHna, "we went"), رحتو (riHtaw, "you-all went"), راحو (raaHaw, "they went").
a2-past-raah.fact: Notice the vowel shift: the medial "aa" of راح shortens to a plain "i" in every person except he/she/they (راح/راحت/راحو keep the long "aa"). This a→i shift in all-but-third-person is a very common pattern across Gulf Arabic past-tense verbs, not unique to راح.

dialogue.en: I went home, and I saw the family, good

a2-past-shaaf.title: Past Tense: I Saw, You Saw...
a2-past-shaaf.pattern: شفت / شفت / شفتي / شاف / شافت / شفنا / شفتو / شافو
a2-past-shaaf.explanation: The past tense of شاف (shaaf, "to see") follows the same pattern as راح: شفت (shift, "I saw"), شفت (shift, "you-m saw"), شفتي (shifti, "you-f saw"), شاف (shaaf, "he saw"), شافت (shaafat, "she saw"), شفنا (shifna, "we saw"), شفتو (shiftaw, "you-all saw"), شافو (shaafaw, "they saw").
a2-past-shaaf.fact: Many Emirati speakers pronounce this verb with چ instead of ش (چاف/چفت, chaaf/chift) — a well-known regional sound shift found in parts of the UAE and wider Gulf, and both pronunciations are considered correct.

dialogue.en: Did you (f) see the family yesterday?

dialogue.native: نعم، شفت الأهل، وشفت صديق زين
dialogue.en: Yes, I saw the family, and I saw a good friend

a2-past-negation.title: Negating the Past: Ma + Past Verb
a2-past-negation.explanation: To negate a past-tense verb, put ما (ma) right before it, exactly like with the present tense: ما رحت (ma riHt, "I didn't go"), ما شفت (ma shift, "I didn't see").
a2-past-negation.fact: Unlike the present tense (which splits between ما for verbs and مب for nominal sentences), the past tense always uses ما — there's no مب-equivalent for past-tense negation, which simplifies this pattern compared to the present.

dialogue.en: Did you see the family yesterday?

dialogue.native: لا، ما شفت الأهل، رحت الحين بس
dialogue.en: No, I didn't see the family, I only went now

a2-days-past.title: Days of the Week with Past Tense
a2-days-past.explanation: Combining a day name with a past-tense verb is a natural way to build a simple narrative: يوم الجمعة رحت البيت (yoom el-jum3a riHt el-bayt, "On Friday I went home"). The day name simply comes first, exactly like a time adverb.
a2-days-past.fact: Notice there's no extra preposition needed before the day name ("on Friday") — Emirati, like most Gulf dialects, places time expressions directly at the start of the sentence without a linking word.

lessons.title: Visiting My Grandparents
lessons.context: A passage about visiting grandparents in another city.

paragraphs.ar: كل يوم جمعة نزور جدي وجدتي.
paragraphs.en: Every Friday we visit my grandfather and grandmother.

paragraphs.ar: بيتهم بعيد شوي، نسوق ساعة تقريبا.
paragraphs.en: Their house is a bit far, we drive about an hour.

paragraphs.ar: جدتي تسوي لنا أكل وايد لذيذ.
paragraphs.en: My grandmother makes us a lot of delicious food.

paragraphs.ar: جدي يحكي لنا قصص عن أيامه.
paragraphs.en: My grandfather tells us stories about his old days.

questions.question: When do they visit the grandparents?
How far is the grandparents' house?
What does the grandfather do?
options: Tells stories about his old days

lessons.title: A Dusty Day
lessons.context: A passage about a dusty, windy day.

paragraphs.en: Today the weather has a lot of dust.
We couldn't see far well.
We stayed at home most of the day.
We played games and drank tea.

questions.question: Where did they stay most of the day?
What did they do at home?

lessons.title: Shopping for Eid Clothes
lessons.context: A passage about buying new clothes before Eid.

paragraphs.ar: قبل العيد رحنا نشتري ملابس جديدة.
paragraphs.en: Before Eid, we went to buy new clothes.
My sister bought a beautiful green dress.
I bought a new white kandura.
We were very happy with the new clothes.

questions.question: How did they feel about the new clothes?

lessons.title: A Test at School
lessons.context: A passage about studying for a test.

paragraphs.en: Today I had a math test.
I studied a lot last night.

paragraphs.ar: الامتحان كان صعب شوي بس قدرت أحله.
paragraphs.en: The test was a bit hard but I managed to solve it.
After the test, I played with my friends.

questions.question: What subject was the test in?
What did the speaker do after the test?

lessons.title: The Camel Farm
lessons.context: A passage about visiting a camel farm.

paragraphs.en: My uncle has a farm with camels.
We visited him on Saturday and saw the camels.

paragraphs.ar: أعطينا الجمال أكل وشربنا حليب طازة.
paragraphs.en: We fed the camels and drank fresh milk.
It was a very nice visit.

questions.question: What did they give the camels?

lessons.title: At the Doctor
lessons.context: A passage about a visit to the doctor.

paragraphs.en: I have been sick for two days.
I went to the doctor this morning.

paragraphs.ar: الدكتور قال لي خذ راحة واشرب مي وايد.
paragraphs.en: The doctor told me to rest and drink a lot of water.
Now I feel a bit better.

questions.question: How long has the speaker been sick?
When did they go to the doctor?
What did the doctor advise?
options: Rest and drink a lot of water

questions.question: How does the speaker feel now?

lessons.title: The Football Match
lessons.context: A passage about watching a football match.

paragraphs.ar: أمس شفنا مباراة كورة مع أصحابي.
paragraphs.en: Yesterday we watched a football match with my friends.
The team I like won by two goals.
We shouted and celebrated a lot.
It was an exciting and great match.

questions.question: Who did the speaker watch the match with?
How many goals did the team win by?
What did they do when the team won?

lessons.title: Helping Mom Cook
lessons.context: A passage about helping in the kitchen.

paragraphs.ar: كل نهاية أسبوع أساعد أمي بالطبخ.
paragraphs.en: Every weekend I help my mother cook.
Yesterday we made chicken machboos.
I cut the vegetables and my mother cooked the chicken.

paragraphs.ar: أكلنا الغدا مع بعض وكان لذيذ وايد.
paragraphs.en: We ate lunch together and it was very delicious.

questions.question: When does the speaker help their mother cook?

lessons.title: A Birthday Party
lessons.context: A passage about a birthday celebration.

paragraphs.en: Yesterday was my sister's birthday.
We had a small party at home.
We brought a cake and delicious sweets.
My sister was very happy with the party.

lessons.title: A Trip to the Mall
lessons.context: A passage about a shopping trip to the mall.

paragraphs.ar: يوم السبت رحنا المول مع أصحابي.
paragraphs.en: On Saturday we went to the mall with my friends.
We looked around at a lot of shops.

paragraphs.ar: أكلنا في مطعم زين ولعبنا ألعاب.
paragraphs.en: We ate at a good restaurant and played games.
We spent a very nice day at the mall.

questions.question: When did they go to the mall?

lessons.title: A Trip to Abu Dhabi
lessons.context: A passage about a family trip to Abu Dhabi.

paragraphs.en: Last week we traveled to Abu Dhabi.

paragraphs.ar: زرنا الجامع الكبير، كان حلو وايد.
paragraphs.en: We visited the Grand Mosque, it was very beautiful.

paragraphs.ar: مشينا على الكورنيش وتفرجنا على البحر.
paragraphs.en: We walked on the corniche and looked at the sea.
We returned to Dubai at night, tired.

questions.question: When did they travel to Abu Dhabi?
What did they do on the corniche?
options: Walked and looked at the sea

questions.question: When did they return to Dubai?

lessons.title: Learning to Swim
lessons.context: A passage about learning to swim.

paragraphs.en: I started learning to swim this summer.
I go to the pool twice a week.

paragraphs.ar: أول مرة كنت خايف من المي.
paragraphs.en: The first time, I was afraid of the water.
Now I swim well and I'm not afraid.

questions.question: When did the speaker start learning to swim?
How often do they go to the pool?
How did they feel the first time?

lessons.title: A Power Outage
lessons.context: A passage about an evening without electricity.

paragraphs.en: Yesterday at night, the electricity suddenly went out.
We sat with candles and talked with each other.
After an hour, the electricity came back.

paragraphs.ar: كانت ليلة غريبة بس حلوة شوي.
paragraphs.en: It was a strange night but a bit nice.

questions.question: What did they do during the outage?
How long was the electricity out?
How did the speaker describe the night?

lessons.title: Planting a Tree
lessons.context: A passage about planting a tree in the garden.

paragraphs.en: Yesterday we planted a tree in the garden.

paragraphs.ar: أبوي حفر حفرة وأنا حطيت الشجرة.
paragraphs.en: My father dug a hole and I placed the tree.
We watered it a lot.

paragraphs.ar: بعد سنين بتصير شجرة كبيرة إن شاء الله.
paragraphs.en: In a few years, it will become a big tree, God willing.

questions.question: Where did they plant the tree?
What did they do after planting?
What do they hope for the tree?
options: That it becomes a big tree
That someone else takes care of it

lessons.title: A Picnic in the Desert
lessons.context: A passage about a desert picnic.

paragraphs.ar: يوم الخميس رحنا البر مع العائلة.
paragraphs.en: On Thursday we went to the desert with the family.
We made a fire and grilled meat.
The children played in the sand and laughed a lot.

paragraphs.ar: رجعنا البيت متأخر بس كنا مبسوطين.
paragraphs.en: We returned home late but we were happy.

questions.question: When did they go to the desert?
What did they do there?
options: Made a fire and grilled meat

questions.question: What did the children do?
options: Played in the sand and laughed

lessons.title: Fixing My Bike
lessons.context: A passage about repairing a bicycle.

paragraphs.en: My bike has been broken for a week.
My father helped me fix it today.
We changed the wheel and cleaned it.
Now it works well and I can ride it.

questions.question: How long was the bike broken?
How does the bike work now?

lessons.title: A Lost Phone
lessons.context: A passage about losing and finding a phone.

paragraphs.en: Yesterday I lost my phone at the mall.
I looked for it everywhere.
Later, someone found it and gave it to security.
I went and got it, and I was very relieved.

questions.question: Where did the speaker lose their phone?
Who found the phone?
options: Someone, who gave it to security

questions.question: How did the speaker feel afterward?

lessons.title: A Rainy Day in Winter
lessons.context: A passage about a rare rainy day.

paragraphs.en: It's rare to see rain where we live.
Yesterday, a lot of rain fell suddenly.
The children went out to play in the rain and laughed.
It was a different and very nice day.

questions.question: How common is rain in this place?
What did the children do?
options: Went out to play and laughed

lessons.title: My Neighbor's New Baby
lessons.context: A passage about a neighbor's new baby.

paragraphs.ar: جارتنا خلفت ولد جديد الأسبوع اللي طاف.
paragraphs.en: Our neighbor had a new baby last week.
We visited her and brought a gift for the baby.
The baby is very cute and calm.
The whole family is very happy with him.
